criterion_assessments.assessment: Identity scope, noninteractive trust refusal, helper invalidation, narrow existing completion regression and new help/snippet/startup behavior are separately covered.
Path classification, late conflict with unchanged sentinels and actual client settings preservation cover preflight and valid writes.
Caught failures, abrupt termination/restart, repeated recovery, retained backup on recovery failure and intervening client edits are explicit.
Literal data/URL parsing, restrictive creation/replacement, unsafe paths, MCP opt-in, staged credential migration and fresh PTY setup are explicit.
Reviewed immutable dependency/source identities, mismatch-before-execution, approval-before-fetch and all caller failure propagation are mapped.
One allowlist builder, static and instrumented runners, owned metadata, private/staging-safe outputs and successful public verification are covered.
Exact scalar round-trip and invalid late-runtime rejection before publication are tested across generated formats and override inputs.
Argument precedence has unit coverage and actual listener binding has integration coverage; argv-only evidence cannot substitute.
One complete Grill decision, defaults versus explicit exceptions, persistence and an end-to-end model-flow journey are mapped.
Saved choice precedence, independent review, real escalations, continuation and legacy workstreams without invented policy consent are covered.
Runtime ordering/access, exact overrides, real parent identity, automatic switch verification, manual acknowledgment provenance and plan-only stop are separately asserted.
Portable model resolution, regenerated projections and unknown/unsupported capability evidence are covered; fake adapters do not claim live vendor support.
